terms.def_en: A cartridge of 11 thin tubes whose walls have 0.2 µm pores (Cobetter MiniLab, mPES, 200 cm²). Culture flows inside the tubes, secreted protein crosses the wall, cells cannot. It makes the harvest and holds the bacteria in.
terms.def_zh: 一個含 11 根細管的濾芯（Cobetter MiniLab，mPES，面積 200 cm²），管壁孔徑 0.2 µm。菌液在管內流動，分泌的蛋白質可穿過管壁，細菌不能。它同時負責收成產物並把細菌留在系統內。

terms.def_en: Lumen is the inside of the fibers, where the engineered B. subtilis circulates. Shell is the space around the fibers, where cell-free protectant collects and leaves. Only the fiber wall connects the two.
terms.def_zh: 管腔側（lumen）是纖維內部，基因改造枯草桿菌在這裡循環；殼側（shell）是纖維外圍的空間，收集不含細胞的保護物並送出。兩側只靠纖維管壁相通。
terms.src: hardware-bioreactor#3.4 The System, Stage by Stage

terms.def_en: Continuous culture where fresh medium goes in and product-bearing liquid comes out while the cells are kept, so density stays high. In ReLEAF the 0.2 µm membrane does the keeping; the longest logged run is 116 h.
terms.def_zh: 灌流培養：新鮮培養基持續進入、含產物的液體持續流出，細胞則被留在系統裡，所以細胞密度能維持很高。ReLEAF 由 0.2 µm 膜負責留住細胞；最長的一次運轉記錄了 116 小時。

terms.def_en: Dead-end filtration pushes all the liquid straight at the membrane, so cells pile up. Cross-flow sweeps the culture along the fiber walls while only part crosses, which keeps the surface cleaner. ReLEAF runs cross-flow.
terms.def_zh: 死端過濾是把液體整個壓向膜面，細胞會堆積；錯流（cross-flow）則讓菌液沿著纖維管壁流過，只有一部分穿過膜，膜面比較不容易堵。ReLEAF 採用錯流。

terms.def_en: The pressure that pushes liquid across the wall: TMP = (feed + retentate) / 2 minus permeate. Three transducers feed it. Runs sat near 0.03 bar; the pinch valve raised it to about 0.16 bar for 60 s to harvest.
terms.def_zh: 推動液體穿過膜壁的壓力：TMP =（進料壓＋回流壓）÷ 2 − 滲透側壓，由三個壓力感測器計算。運轉時約 0.03 bar；收成時夾管閥關閉 60 秒，升到約 0.16 bar。
terms.src: hardware-bioreactor#4.1 Hollow Fiber Membrane, DBTL 1; results#Pressure and sampling

kw_zh: 每平方公尺每小時幾公升
terms.def_en: Flux is permeate volume per membrane area per hour; LMH is liters per square meter per hour. The 200 cm² module at 2 LMH gives 0.67 mL/min. Runs drew 12 to 24 mL/min, which is 36 to 72 LMH.
terms.def_zh: 通量（flux）是單位膜面積、單位時間內通過的濾液量；LMH 是每平方公尺每小時幾公升。200 cm² 的模組在 2 LMH 時約 0.67 mL/min；實際運轉抽取 12 至 24 mL/min，也就是 36 至 72 LMH。

terms.def_en: Fouling is cells and debris caking on the membrane so resistance rises. Critical flux is the flux below which that is negligible; the model gives 46 LMH at 263 mL/min. At the 2 LMH design flux, J/Jcrit is 0.04.
terms.def_zh: 積垢（fouling）是細胞與碎屑附著在膜面使阻力上升。臨界通量是低於它就幾乎不會積垢的通量；模型算出在 263 mL/min 時為 46 LMH。以設計通量 2 LMH 計，J/Jcrit 為 0.04。
terms.src: biomanufacturing#Critical flux and the fouling margin

terms.def_en: How fast liquid is sheared at the fiber wall, in s⁻¹. At 263 mL/min with 11 fibers it is about 4060 s⁻¹, inside the vendor window of 2000 to 6000. Culture viability at that shear has not been read.
terms.def_zh: 液體在纖維管壁被剪切的速度，單位 s⁻¹。以 11 根纖維計，263 mL/min 時約為 4060 s⁻¹，落在廠商建議的 2000 至 6000 s⁻¹ 內。在這個剪切下的細胞存活率沒有測過。
terms.src: hardware-bioreactor#4.1 DBTL 3; measurement#Flow and pressure monitoring

terms.def_en: The fitted link between flow Q and pressure drop ΔP: linear friction plus minor losses at valves and fittings. Running the loop with and without the module showed plumbing is 46 to 55% of the drop. R² was 0.995 on 16 August.
terms.def_zh: 流量 Q 與壓降 ΔP 的擬合關係：一次項是層流摩擦，二次項是閥與接頭的局部損失。有、無模組各測一次，發現管路佔壓降的 46 至 55%。8 月 16 日的 R² 為 0.995。

terms.def_en: A pump that squeezes silicone tubing from outside, so the fluid never touches the pump head. It drives the loop; 263 mL/min is the recommended flow. A magnetic pump was tried for long runs but could not move the medium.
terms.def_zh: 從外側擠壓矽膠管來推動液體的幫浦，液體不會接觸幫浦本體。它驅動整個循環，建議流量為 263 mL/min。團隊也試過磁力幫浦，但它推不動培養基，所以放棄。

terms.def_en: A servo that clamps the culture return line to raise pressure across the fibers and push product to the shell side. Prof. Chang noted that raising flow alone gives no outward force. One minute closed gave 20 to 30 mL.
terms.def_zh: 一個伺服馬達夾住培養液回流管，使纖維兩側壓力升高，把產物推向殼側。張嘉修教授指出光加大流量只會循環、沒有向外的推力。夾閉一分鐘可得約 20 至 30 mL。

terms.def_en: Ceramic gauge sensor, 0 to 1 MPa, 1.0% of full scale overall, about 0.1 bar. Three read feed, retentate and permeate. TMP is only a few kPa, so fouling has to be read as a trend, not from one value.
terms.def_zh: 陶瓷壓力傳送器，量程 0 至 1 MPa，整體準確度為滿量程的 1.0%（約 0.1 bar）。三個分別讀進料、回流、滲透側。TMP 只有幾 kPa，所以積垢要看趨勢，不能看單一數值。
terms.src: hardware-bioreactor#4.1 DBTL 1; biomanufacturing#Oxygen, energy and dead time

terms.def_en: A magnet on a spinning rotor gives one pulse per pass, and pulse frequency gives flow. It costs US$2 and agreed with catching the outflow by hand at R² 0.995. It replaced hand timing after the 14 August readings varied by operator.
terms.def_zh: 轉子上的磁鐵每轉過感測器一次就產生一個脈衝，脈衝頻率即流量。單價 US$2，與手動接水量測比對的 R² 為 0.995。8 月 14 日的手動讀數因人而異，之後就改用它。
terms.src: measurement#How the flow was measured; hardware-bioreactor#10.1

terms.def_en: A 12 V bus servo driven over UART. Five are used: one on the pinch valve, four on automated Luer valves. Owl Lab advised it because the PCA9685 driver could stop at 85° when told 90°, and a missed valve can spike pressure.
terms.def_zh: 以 UART 控制的 12 V 序列匯流排伺服馬達。系統用了五顆：一顆夾管閥、四顆自動 Luer 閥。Owl Lab 建議採用，因為原本的 PCA9685 驅動板下令 90° 時可能只轉到 85°，閥位不準會造成壓力突升。

terms.term: Arduino UNO Q and the mainboard
terms.def_en: The controller: a microcontroller side reads sensors and holds interlocks, a Linux side serves the dashboard. It runs 3.3 V logic. The mainboard brings out every pin with a 12 V to 5 V and 3.3 V converter so sensors plug in as modules.
terms.def_zh: 控制器：微控制器端讀感測器並執行保護機制，Linux 端提供儀表板；使用 3.3 V 邏輯。主機板把每支腳位引出並內建 12 V 轉 5 V、3.3 V 的轉換器，讓感測器像模組一樣插上去。

terms.def_en: Steam sterilization at 121 °C for 15 to 30 minutes. ReLEAF autoclaves solid biological waste and bleaches liquids, at BSL-1. The assembled bioreactor loop cannot go into an autoclave, so it is cleaned in place with peroxide instead.
terms.def_zh: 以 121 °C 蒸氣滅菌 15 至 30 分鐘。ReLEAF 在 BSL-1 下把固態生物廢棄物高壓滅菌、液體廢棄物用漂白水處理。組裝好的反應器循環放不進高壓滅菌鍋，所以改用過氧化氫現場清潔。

terms.def_en: Sterilizing the assembled loop: 900 mL water and 100 mL of 35% H₂O₂ circulate for 15 min, starch–iodide paper checks for peroxide, then about five 1 L rinses. In integrated run 3 undiluted peroxide reached a Luer valve, which broke at 38 h.
terms.def_zh: 現場滅菌組裝好的循環：900 mL 水加 100 mL 35% H₂O₂ 循環 15 分鐘，用澱粉碘化物試紙檢查過氧化氫，再以約五次 1 L 水沖洗。整合第三次運轉中未稀釋的過氧化氫流到 Luer 閥，閥在 38 小時斷裂。

terms.def_en: One-sided feedback: when lumen pH falls to 6.8, a pump adds 5 mL of 1 M KOH per minute until pH 7.0. It worked the first night; then KOH corroded the feeding valve and the team dosed by hand once a day.
terms.def_zh: 單向回饋控制：管腔側 pH 降到 6.8 時，幫浦每分鐘加 5 mL 的 1 M KOH，直到 pH 回到 7.0。第一晚運作正常，之後 KOH 腐蝕進料閥，改成每天手動加一次。

terms.def_en: An OD600 sensor inside the loop, so no sample is drawn. The Pro has a 600 nm LED, lens and 90:10 beam splitter. The Slim uses two optical fibers, reads about one fifth as high, and needs a ×5.57 factor.
terms.def_zh: 裝在循環管路內的 OD600 感測器，不需抽樣。Pro 使用 600 nm LED、透鏡與 90:10 分光鏡；Slim 改用兩條光纖，讀數約為 Pro 的五分之一，需乘上 ×5.57。

kw_zh: 約 240 小時後參考通道故障
terms.def_en: A second sensor sees 10% of the LED light without the culture, so OD comes from a ratio and slow LED drift cancels. Clean medium gives about 9:1. In the 434 h run the reference channel itself failed after about 240 h.
terms.def_zh: 第二個感測器看到不經過菌液的 10% LED 光，所以 OD 由比值得出，LED 的緩慢漂移會被抵消。乾淨培養基的比值約 9:1。在 434 小時的運轉中，參考通道本身約在 240 小時後故障。

terms.def_en: The flow cuvette is 2 mm thick, not the standard 10 mm. Software multiplies the absorbance by 5 (10 mm ÷ 2 mm) so it reads as OD600. The short path keeps a dense culture from saturating the reading.
terms.def_zh: 流動槽厚 2 mm，不是標準的 10 mm。軟體把吸光度乘以 5（10 mm ÷ 2 mm），讓結果以 OD600 呈現。短光徑可避免高密度培養液讓讀值飽和。

terms.term: Burst, MAD filter and acceptance gate
terms.def_en: Each reading is a burst of 16 lux samples; the first 2 are dropped and the rest cut at median ± 3 MAD. Two gates then reject a reading whose estimators differ by over 0.03 OD or that jumps over 0.05 OD or 5%.
terms.def_zh: 每筆讀數是 16 次照度取樣，丟掉前 2 次，其餘依中位數 ± 3 MAD 剔除離群值。接著兩道閘門：兩種估計值相差超過 0.03 OD，或與上一筆相差超過 0.05 OD 或 5%，該筆讀數就被擋下。

terms.def_en: The reading with no bacteria, used to set K, the sample-to-reference ratio of clean medium. A wrong blank shifts every later point: one taken through a dirty window read four times high. A blank can now be typed in by hand.
terms.def_zh: 沒有細菌時的讀數，用來決定 K，也就是乾淨培養基的樣品對參考比值。空白錯了，之後每一點都會偏移：隔著髒窗口測的空白曾讀高四倍。現在可以手動輸入空白值。

terms.term: BioDrop and the TiO₂ / SiO₂ standards
terms.def_en: BioDrop is the benchtop spectrophotometer used as the reference, diluted above OD 1. TiO₂ (cheap) and iGEM's SiO₂ are non-living particle standards. Neither tells you a cell count; that needs plate counts, not yet done.
terms.def_zh: BioDrop 是當作參考的桌上型分光光度計，OD 超過 1 要先稀釋。TiO₂（便宜）與 iGEM 標準的 SiO₂ 是非活體顆粒標準品。兩者都不能換算成細胞數，那需要菌落計數，目前還沒做。

kw_zh: 量的是 lux 不是光子
terms.def_en: A BH1750 chip lux meter. Two share one I²C bus in the photometer, one for the sample and one for the reference. Lux is illuminance weighted for the human eye, so ReLEAF uses the ratio of the two, not the absolute number.
terms.def_zh: BH1750 晶片照度計。光度計內兩個共用一條 I²C 匯流排，一個量樣品、一個量參考。lux 是依人眼敏感度加權的照度，所以 ReLEAF 用兩者的比值，而不是絕對數值。

terms.def_en: A holder of 24 culture tubes on an 18 mm pitch, each above its own LED. Green and red at low, mid and high give six conditions with four replicates. One Arduino and three MOSFETs drive it. The design follows Gerhardt et al. 2016.
terms.def_zh: 一個容納 24 支培養管（間距 18 mm）的架子，每支管下方有自己的 LED。綠光與紅光各分低、中、高，共六種條件、每種四重複。由一個 Arduino 與三個 MOSFET 驅動。設計參考 Gerhardt 等人 2016。

kw_en: team's internal name for the LPA
terms.def_en: The team's internal name for the LPA hardware; it shows in the page address and STL file names. The page itself is titled LPA: Light Plate Apparatus and the wiki does not spell out DiOPAL, so do not make up an expansion.
terms.def_zh: 團隊對 LPA 硬體的內部稱呼，出現在網址與 STL 檔名中。頁面標題是 LPA: Light Plate Apparatus，wiki 沒有說明 DiOPAL 的全名，所以不要自己編造。

terms.def_en: The Arduino switches an LED on and off very fast; the share of time it is on, the duty cycle, sets the average brightness. The LPA tiers use analogWrite 5, 31 and 255 on pins 9, 10, 11: about 2%, 12% and 100%.
terms.def_zh: Arduino 讓 LED 極快地開關，開啟時間所佔的比例（工作週期）決定平均亮度。LPA 在腳位 9、10、11 用 analogWrite 5、31、255，約為 2%、12%、100%。

kw_en: photon flux is what cells use
kw_zh: 光子通量才是細胞用的
terms.def_en: Lux weights light by human vision, so green counts far more than red. Photon flux counts the photons the bacteria can use. The LPA reports lux only, so green and red doses are not comparable; photon flux is stated as future work.
terms.def_zh: lux 依人眼視覺加權，綠光的權重遠高於紅光；光子通量則是計算細菌可用的光子數。LPA 只報告 lux，因此綠光與紅光的劑量不能直接比較；光子通量被列為未來工作。

terms.def_en: Each LED was measured at 5 V and sorted into groups of four. Before sorting green varied by 26% and red by 22%; inside a group they agree within 0.4 to 1.8%. Groups differ little from each other, so PWM sets the tiers.
terms.def_zh: 每顆 LED 在 5 V 下逐一量測，再四顆一組。分組前綠光差異 26%、紅光 22%；同組內相差 0.4 至 1.8%。各組之間差異很小，所以強度層級改由 PWM 設定。

terms.def_en: A two-component light switch: green light activates CcaS, which activates CcaR and the production genes; red switches CcaS off. The wiki gives 520/660, 535/670 and 525/630 nm for green and red, and says the red LEDs emit at 640 nm.
terms.def_zh: 兩成分光開關：綠光活化 CcaS，再活化 CcaR 與生產基因；紅光把 CcaS 關掉。wiki 對綠光與紅光分別寫 520/660、535/670、525/630 nm，結果頁還說紅光 LED 實際發光約 640 nm。

kw_en: floats on its own sealed air
terms.def_en: A printed Arabidopsis plate with two sealed air pontoons (42.27 cm³), so roots stay at one depth as the medium falls. Thirteen seedlings, sixteen printed pieces, no glue, in a 1000 µL pipette-tip box under a black box.
terms.def_zh: 印出來的阿拉伯芥浮板，兩個密封氣室浮筒（共 42.27 cm³），培養液下降時根仍維持在同一深度。可放 13 株幼苗，由 16 個列印零件組成、不用膠，放在 1000 µL 吸管尖盒中並套上黑盒。

terms.def_en: Freeboard is the height of the slab above the water; the load line is the computed freeboard for each load. About 1 mm lower per 3.5 g; 4.8 mm predicted at 71.3 g. It is computed from the STL files, not measured on a print.
terms.def_zh: 乾舷（freeboard）是板面高出水面的高度；載重線是每種載重下算出的乾舷。每增加約 3.5 g 下沉約 1 mm；71.3 g 時預測為 4.8 mm。數值由 STL 幾何算出，沒有在實際列印件上量過。

terms.def_en: The SN-3001-YM-N01 reads leaf temperature and leaf wetness over RS485; an SHT31 gives air temperature and humidity. Leaf minus air flags water stress, and wetness drives the rice blast rule. Wetness read 0.0% because it was never wetted.
terms.def_zh: SN-3001-YM-N01 以 RS485 讀葉溫與葉面濕度，SHT31 提供空氣溫濕度。葉溫減氣溫用來判斷水分逆境，葉面濕度用於稻熱病規則。濕度讀到 0.0%，因為從未被弄濕。
terms.src: software#The leaf and air sensors on the bench

kw_zh: 兩支 DO 探頭未安裝
terms.def_en: Two dissolved-oxygen probes were tried, but calibration did not hold and neither can be autoclaved, so no DO is measured. A DS18B20 temperature probe is fitted but not responding; runs used a temperature typed in by the operator.
terms.def_zh: 曾嘗試兩支溶氧探頭，但校正無法維持、也不能高壓滅菌，所以沒有任何溶氧數據。DS18B20 溫度探頭已安裝但沒有回應，運轉時使用操作員手動輸入的溫度。

terms.def_en: Pressure trip: firmware stops both pumps and releases the pinch valve above 0.70 bar; it was armed in the 77-hour run, peak 0.57 bar. Droplet sensor: a moisture sensor under the loop, which the bioreactor page calls planned.
terms.def_zh: 壓力跳脫：壓力超過 0.70 bar 時，韌體停止兩個幫浦並放開夾管閥；77 小時那次運轉中待命，最高 0.57 bar。漏液感測器：裝在迴路下方的濕度感測器，反應器頁面說仍在規劃。

terms.term: Bill of materials (BOM) and known costs
kw_en: controller and KOH pump not listed
kw_zh: 控制器與 KOH 幫浦未列入
terms.def_en: The priced parts list. Bioreactor known costs are US$1022.67. It leaves out the UNO Q, the mainboard with its converter, the KOH dosing pump and the stir bar, and the pinch-valve nuts and screws are not priced.
terms.def_zh: 有標價的零件清單。反應器已知成本為 US$1022.67；其中沒有列入 UNO Q、含轉換器的主機板、KOH 加料幫浦與攪拌子，夾管閥的螺帽螺絲也未計價。

terms.def_en: The Digital Twin labels each channel live, bench tested, tested not integrated, experimented not integrated, or external. Use these words when asked what the system really measures: green light and DO are not live, leaf sensor is bench only.
terms.def_zh: 數位孿生為每個通道標示：運轉中、桌上測試、測過但未整合、實驗過但未整合、外部資料。被問到系統實際量什麼時用這些詞：綠光與 DO 不是運轉中，葉片感測器只做過桌上測試。

terms.def_en: A log reduction counts how many powers of ten of bacteria a barrier removes; a detection limit is the smallest count the plating can see. Both containment platings gave zero shell colonies, but neither number was recorded, so no log reduction is claimed.
terms.def_zh: 對數減量是屏障去除了幾個數量級的細菌；偵測極限是平板法能看見的最小菌量。兩次殼側平板都沒長出菌落，但這兩個數字都沒有記錄，所以不宣稱任何對數減量。

kw_en: light switch ran on LPA only
kw_zh: 光開關只在 LPA 測
terms.def_en: A constitutive promoter is always on. Every integrated bioreactor run used it, so light control was out of the test and the loop itself was examined. Light-switched expression with CcaS/CcaR was tested on the LPA only.
terms.def_zh: 組成型啟動子是持續表現的。所有整合反應器運轉都用它，所以光控制不在測試之內，被檢驗的是循環系統本身。CcaS/CcaR 的光控表現只在 LPA 上測過。
